definitions.explanation: A common Japanese surname, built from {藤|ふじ} (wisteria) + {田|た} (rice field), a combination typical of surnames tied to the {藤原|ふじわら} clan and to farming geography.

examples.japanese: {藤田|ふじた}さん、⟦おはようございます→おはようございます：30844_ohayougozaimasu⟧。
⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{藤田|ふじた}さん⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{名字|みょうじ}だ。
examples.english: The family next door has the surname Fujita.

examples.japanese: {藤田|ふじた}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{名字|みょうじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The surname Fujita is found all over the country.

notes:
{藤田|ふじた} is one of many common surnames built on ⟦{藤|ふじ}→藤：04396_fuji⟧ (wisteria), the element also seen in {藤原|ふじわら} and ⟦{藤井|ふじい}→藤井：30977_fujii⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{藤田|ふじた} is usually a place-based name (a rice field where wisteria grew). The traditional link to the {藤原|ふじわら} clan is claimed mainly for surnames ending in {藤|とう}, such as ⟦{佐藤|さとう}→佐藤：27597_satou⟧ and {加藤|かとう}.
